findings.body: The unavailable-reason renderer still iterates only `ALL_GANTRY_MCP_TOOL_NAMES`, excluding Gantry facade capabilities. DeepAgents omits RunCommand when its host flag or grant is absent (`apps/core/src/adapters/llm/deepagents-langchain/runner/mcp-tools.ts:375`), while scheduled Claude runs omit RunCommand, FileEdit and FileWrite through their native selection (`apps/core/src/adapters/llm/anthropic-claude-agent/agent-capabilities.ts:234`; native definitions in `native-sdk-tools.ts:10`). None receives an unavailable reason. The boundary test explicitly observes RunCommand's absence at lines 528 and 629, but its expected reason map excludes facade tools, so the final assertion at line 642 passes despite this omission. Extend both the renderer's inventory and the independent boundary expectations to cover these runner decisions. The browser credential repair works, but the promised coverage of every unavailable capability remains incomplete.
